notes: The survey for this slice was strong. Versions, line references, devlog references, ledger lines and every 'VV lacks X' claim held up: 27 identifiers were searched across all of VVM and none had an equivalent under another name. Nothing was refuted outright. Its main weakness is sequencing. It recommends whole-file takes of Viewport2d, Frame, Linework, Window, Viewport3d, ViewportIdentity, EdgeStyles and ModelLayers 'once the enabling leaves exist'. Resolving every import against VV shows that those files pull in ModelSource, PlanDoors, DepthFog, the site plan Store and painter, Draft State and pieces from folders 50, 43, 46 and 49. A whole-file take before all of these exist breaks the lazy loader's import(), and the editor will not open. Every feature WP must therefore replay hunks, with one convergence step at the end (V01, WP-14). A verbatim ModelSource also drags the whole site plan client in, through an import cycle with Linework, so WP-05 must use an adapted copy. Other material fixes: (1) VV's interim Describe must return a modelSource stub, never null. (2) Handles 1.5.0 is not harmless on its own; it draws a rotate grip. (3) A seventh DIV seam exists (section serialise/apply), and section calls bypass the adapter in both apps, including the fog layer's RenderDepthInto (V03, WP-15). (4) The site plan tab group is obsolete since TV v2.158.0. (5) Vale GLBs already use TrueVision__ stems and VV renames them at load, so the stem decision needs no exporter work (V04). (6) VV keeps unknown record keys; F43 drops to medium. Six packages were replaced by corrected 'R' versions, plus WP-01R for the Describe stub. WP-02, 04, 06, 09 and 12 stand. WP-09's risk line wrongly lists 46 AutoName, which is a record key, not an import. Watch for: the sign-off markers (D-S04a-10); the coupling of D-S04a-02's payoff to D-S04a-01 = B; and the fact that the Plugins exporters and the Whitecardopedia sync were not read. The report is updated in place with a Verification section.
